Geographic data: Natural Earth. Public domain.
Source: https://github.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector
World coastline derived from geojson/ne_50m_land.geojson, simplified at 0.075 degrees.
Shanghai-region coastline derived from geojson/ne_10m_land.geojson, clipped to 117–126 E, 27–36 N, simplified at 0.0008 degrees.
Retrieved 2026-09-26. Geography is generalized and not a surveying or navigation basemap.

d3-array 3.2.4 and d3-geo 3.1.1, ISC license.

The Shanghai anchor (121.6000 E, 31.2000 N) is a hypothetical location selected
for this demonstration. The campus, buildings, base stations, UE positions and
roads are synthetic and do not describe the real site at that coordinate.
